title: PatientIA
summary: PatientIA is a multi-agent AI system, orchestrated with LangGraph, that analyzes, generates, validates, and simulates synthetic patient data to augment medical datasets for research and model training. Its generation agent directly calls SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer) to produce the synthetic cohorts.
